name: 暗夜金属折叠举重床款
description: 暗夜金属质感、多姿势全身力量训练、可折叠收纳的举重床套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: cinematic dark gradient #0D0F12 to #2B2E33 for hero and scene shots, clean white #FFFFFF and light grey #F4F5F7 for infographic shots, one electric blue accent panel #2A7BFF reserved for the closing shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool directional studio key with controlled speculars on steel and soft contact shadows, 5500K natural window light in lifestyle shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte dark studio floor, textured dark rubber gym matting, brushed dark steel
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, metallic silver short bold headlines with a small electric-blue sub-line
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line callout labels and small square info chips in the single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle and scale for full-product shots; all steel tubes and pad edges must stay perfectly straight
noDrift: no warped or bent frame lines
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark cinematic fitness equipment visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cinematic dark gradient #0D0F12, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one electric blue accent #2A7BFF; cool directional studio lighting with controlled highlights on steel and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif metallic silver short bold headlines with small electric-blue sub-lines; consistent thin-line callout labels and small square info chips in the accent color; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale with perfectly straight steel lines and clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warped or bent frame lines.

shots.intent: 首屏用低角度气势与金属质感一秒赢点击，顶部呈现主卖点文案
shots.camera: photographed from a very low angle looking upward, front 3/4 view, full training station with barbell visible
shots.lighting: cool directional key from the upper left with controlled speculars on the steel frame, soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding the unit
shots.background: cinematic dark gradient #0D0F12 to #2B2E33 with faint out-of-focus city lights
shots.props: a barbell with plates resting on the rack cradles
shots.whitespace: cinematic low-angle composition with the upper sky area kept clean around the headline
shots.textZone: upper-left metallic headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one small accent sub-line 「{callout_1}」 in the clean upper area
shots.promptTemplate: Dramatic e-commerce hero shot of {product} with a barbell resting on the rack cradles. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward at a front 3/4 view, full product visible with perfectly straight steel lines. Cool directional key light from the upper left with controlled highlights on the steel, soft fill, and a soft contact shadow grounding the unit. Cinematic dark gradient background #0D0F12 to #2B2E33 with faint out-of-focus city lights. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame in the lower portion, with the clean upper sky area carrying one short metallic headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one small accent sub-line 「{callout_1}」. 2K commercial quality. Negative: no brand logo, no watermark, no model face, no warped straight lines, no bent frame tubes, no extra text, no garbled characters, no floating product.

shots.intent: 白底干净版面把核心利益与训练方式在一秒内说清

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.props: three small square accent chips and thin-line icons

shots.textZone: right 40% carries one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D and three small square chips 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} on a clean white layout. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown at a slight front 3/4 eye-level angle on the left, full product visible, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadow. Background seamless pure white #FFFFFF. The right 40% carries one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D and three small square chips 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in the accent color with thin-line icons, framed by clean white margins. provenance.notes: 从 9 张多功能举重床爆款详情切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字、健美模特形象、原文案、二维码与会员促销贴片；源图 500KG 承重等数据未采信，规格与资质等不可验证信息一律省略，信任镜以可验证的做工细节呈现；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
